headword: {取締役会|とりしまりやくかい}

definitions.explanation: The decision-making body of a Japanese company composed of its {取締役|とりしまりやく} (directors). Also refers to the actual meeting at which directors deliberate and vote on company matters.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}{取締役会|とりしまりやくかい}がある。
examples.english: There's a board meeting next week.

examples.japanese: {取締役会|とりしまりやくかい}で{合併|がっぺい}が{承認|しょうにん}された。
examples.english: The merger was approved by the board of directors.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{社長|しゃちょう}は{次|つぎ}の{取締役会|とりしまりやくかい}で{正式|せいしき}に{選任|せんにん}される{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: The new president is scheduled to be formally appointed at the next board meeting.

notes:
Compound of {取締役|とりしまりやく} (director) + {会|かい} (meeting/assembly). Standard term in Japanese corporate law.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {取締役会|とりしまりやくかい}を{開|ひら}く: to hold a board meeting
- {取締役会|とりしまりやくかい}で{決議|けつぎ}する: to resolve by the board
- {取締役会|とりしまりやくかい}の{承認|しょうにん}: board approval
- {臨時|りんじ}{取締役会|とりしまりやくかい}: extraordinary board meeting

RELATED WORDS:
- {取締役|とりしまりやく}: director (board member)
- {代表|だいひょう}{取締役|とりしまりやく}: representative director (typically the president/CEO)
- {株主|かぶぬし}{総会|そうかい}: shareholders' general meeting — higher authority for major decisions
